qa_pairs.question: What special tools are required to drive in the radial oil seal?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 23 1 180 and 00 5 500 are required to drive in the radial oil seal against the stop.

qa_pairs.question: What section should be referenced for unscrewing the propeller shaft?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23 00 022 should be referenced for unscrewing the propeller shaft.

qa_pairs.question: What must be done to the holder to drive out the cylindrical pin for the selector rod joint?
qa_pairs.answer: The holder (1) must be taken off of the transmission partially, in order to be able to drive out the cylindrical pin for the selector rod joint.

qa_pairs.question: How do you remove the locking sleeve and cylindrical pin when engaging 3rd gear?
qa_pairs.answer: Push locking sleeve (1) away and drive out cylindrical pin (2).

qa_pairs.question: What tool is specified for driving in the radial oil seal?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 23 1 240 is specified for driving in the radial oil seal.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the sealing lip before installing the radial oil seal?
qa_pairs.answer: Lubricate the sealing lip of the radial oil seal with oil before installation.

qa_pairs.question: What section reference is given for removing the cover with guide tube?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23 11 623 is referenced for removing the cover with guide tube.

qa_pairs.question: What section should be referenced for unscrewing the input flange?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23 12 053 should be referenced for unscrewing the input flange.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure title for the left side of the page?
qa_pairs.answer: REPLACING RADIAL OIL SEAL SELECTOR SHAFT (23 12 083).

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure title for the right side of the page for transmission removed?
qa_pairs.answer: REPLACING RADIAL OIL SEAL FOR INPUT SHAFT - Transmission Removed (23 12 503).

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the sealing lip after driving in the radial oil seal?
qa_pairs.answer: Open end faces transmission and lubricate sealing lip with oil.

qa_pairs.question: What component is being lifted out in the bottom left image?
qa_pairs.answer: The radial oil seal is being lifted out.
